text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Now that the stage is set, it's only fitting that we should be the ones to bring the finale to a close.
text_block_list.orig_text:
舞台が整ったのなら、
最後を飾るのは、
当然
ボクたちの務めだよね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Miss Vision Empress... I shall gift you the most beautiful moment of all!
Witness the descent of the God of Love and Beauty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
幻境竜后さん……
キミに贈るよ、
もっとも美しい瞬間を！
愛と美の神の降臨をご覧よ！
